title: CC Form Engine Form Generator
description: Generates a FormConfig for a model and integrates it into a component

model.description: Name of the model/interface to generate form for (e.g., Employee, Usuario, Client)
model.x-prompt: What is the name of the model/interface?

component.description: Name of the component to integrate the form into (e.g., employee, usuario, client)
component.x-prompt: What is the component name to integrate the form?

path.description: Path where to search for the model and component (default: src/app)

configPath.description: Path where to generate the form config file
